Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *You do not need to attend Irish Championship 2024 in Waterford to become the Irish FMC National Champion.* ## This competition is not recommended for newcomers **Please Note:** As this is the Irish Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes.
